content: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) is an essential tool for detecting and preventing hypoglycemia in individuals who are treated with insulin. This is particularly important for those on intensive insulin regimens or using continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion systems. CGM has the capability to identify hypoglycemic events that occur without symptoms, enabling early intervention to prevent these episodes from escalating into severe hypoglycemia. Real-time CGM devices are especially beneficial because they provide alarms that alert individuals to declining glucose levels, allowing them to take action before severe symptoms develop.
